policy: Only crates classified `library` are candidates for crates.io. Applications are distributed as binaries; internal crates are never published and carry no compatibility promise.

cognicode-core.summary: Code intelligence engine: parsing, symbol graph, analysis services.
cognicode-core.packaged_test_paths_reason: Unit tests inside src/ read these corpora through CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR; the other fixture directories and tests/ are not read by src/ and are excluded.

cognicode-graph-algos.summary: Dependency-free graph algorithms (ranking, communities, dominators, slicing).
consumers: any Rust project needing graph algorithms

cognicode-macros.summary: Procedural macros used by the domain types.
cognicode-macros.packaged_test_paths_reason: trybuild compile-fail cases (44 KiB) travel with the crate so packagers can run its suite.

cognicode-graph-wasm.summary: WebAssembly build of the graph algorithms for browser consumers.
consumers: web front ends that run graph algorithms client-side

cognicode-cli.summary: The `cognicode` command line, distributed as a release binary.

cognicode-mcp.summary: The `cognicode-mcp` server, distributed as a release binary.

cognicode-explorer.summary: Explorer backend; its extraction to a separate repository is tracked by the Explorer decommission task.

cognicode-sandbox.summary: Validation sandbox binary used by the project's own acceptance runs.

cognicode-runtime.summary: Runtime support shared by the binaries; no stable API.

cognicode-ladybug.summary: Graph store adapter; already marked `publish = false`.
